headline: Saint Anselm rise to second on four straight wins
dek: Saint Anselm have won all four matches since their defeat at Adelphi, the latest against Franklin Pierce, and now sit second, four points behind Southern New Hampshire. American International, a point further back, drew with Southern Connecticut on the same day.
displaced_by: Saint Anselm's fourth straight win lifts them to second, and the six-point lead over American International in the standing dek no longer holds

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: Southern New Hampshire's fifty-two goals come from at least sixteen different scorers, so the tallest bar is the work of a squad rather than a single forward.

wire.line: Every programme has now lost at least once; Southern New Hampshire were the last, beaten at Adelphi.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Guillermo Rios has scored fifteen of Franklin Pierce's twenty-nine goals.

findings.text: Southern Connecticut have drawn seven matches, more than any other programme.

findings.label: observed

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Javier Solá Martínez has kept six clean sheets in goal for American International.

last_match.line: Saint Anselm have won every match since losing at Adelphi, and the run has lifted them to second.

next_match.line: American International have yet to lose at home this season, and a win would lift them above their visitors.
